decisionsTitle: The volunteers' page tells the steps and that the organizers will confirm — before the form, after it and in the receipt — and the form is as wide as the register page
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-16:** «trebuie să îi spunem voluntarului care sunt pașii și că urmează să îl aprobăm (similar cu flow-ul participanților)», then «e prea îngust tot formularul». Amends §768 (the page), §773 and §797 (the form and its banner), §754 and §761 (the receipt email).

**Before the form.** `volunteers/ui/VolunteerSteps.tsx` draws «Cum funcționează voluntariatul» under the intro and above «Ce ești dispus(ă) să faci», in the shape of the registration's `RegistrationSteps` (§91): four steps with a glyph each — (1) you fill in the form, (2) you get the receipt email with the agreement you accepted attached, nothing to press, (3) the organizers choose your role and confirm you — you are told by email, with the date and place, the meeting time comes from them, nothing is owed until then — and (4) the day. **Folded**, closed, with a numbered-list glyph and the title in its summary, exactly as the register page folds its own steps (the owner's taste: folds closed with a summary line; the thank-you below keeps the list open). The third step adds the parent's consent that comes first only where the club takes minors (the notice and the agreement in force describe them, §768); the fourth points to the contact person written at the category (§774) only when a drawn category has one. No number and no deadline anywhere in it: a volunteer owes nothing between the form and the role. The intro's sentence «Organizatorii îți aleg apoi rolul și te confirmă.» moved into step 3 — one place says it.

**After the form.** The thank-you is the registration's «Aproape gata, Ana!» for a volunteer (`volunteers/ui/VolunteerDone.tsx`): the green-disc heading (`shared/ui/DoneHeading.tsx`, now the registration's too) «Mulțumim, Ana!» or «Mulțumim!», the lead «Am primit oferta ta pentru {event}, {date}.», the receipt's leaving line in the registration's words (`emailLeavesWords`, `shortScreenEmailLeft`: «pleacă acum» / «pleacă la 10:15» / «a plecat»), then «Ce urmează» as a numbered list in the steps' own message keys (one text, typed once): the receipt email, the parent's consent where minors are taken, the organizers' choice, the day. It replaces the success `Alert`; the test ids `volunteer-done` (now a `role="status"` panel) and `volunteer-done-guardian` stay. **What the volunteers' post can know**: not its outbox row (`submitVolunteer` queues it, the action does not read it back) but the pass the email is due on, which `cachedEmailLeavesAt` gives and the registration's action already keeps. So the action seals the first name, the address, that pass and the send's instant in the registration's own facts cookie (`stashSubmittedFacts`, which gained two optional fields; ten minutes, on the volunteers' path, never in the address, §14.5) and the page reads it on `?volunteer=1` only. Without it (ten minutes gone, another browser) the line says only that the email comes to the address written and promises no hour. It reads the same for a new person and a repeat (BR-REQ-031-01 criterion 3): it is what was typed, not what the list held. The old `Event.volunteers.done` message is gone.

**Shared pieces, no copy.** The step list is `shared/ui/StepList.tsx` (`StepList`, `StepItem`) and the done heading `shared/ui/DoneHeading.tsx`; `RegistrationSteps` and `CheckYourEmail` now draw theirs with them (same markup, same test ids), so the registration's form, its «Aproape gata» screen and the volunteers' page cannot drift.

**The receipt.** `VOLUNTEER_RECEIVED` (templates.ts, both languages) now says «Ce urmează: organizatorii îți aleg rolul și te confirmă. Îți scriem pe email rolul tău, cu data și locul… Până atunci nu ai nimic de făcut» and a line for the day; the subject, the agreement line, the parent's consent line and the not-you line are unchanged. Placeholders only: no number, no deadline, no club name (§357; the paragraphs are plain words around the event the template already names). The club's copy editor starts from the platform's words, so an unedited message shows and sends the new paragraphs; a message the club already saved is an override per type and language and keeps its own words until the club presses «Revino la textul implicit».

**The width.** The page's `Container` is `PAGE_WIDTH` (`xl`), the register page's constant; the form `Stack` lost its 560-pixel cap (§780's follow-up: two-column tiles were narrow on desktop). The category cards, the chips and the banner (§797) span the column. The boxes are the registration form's pairing: one column on a phone, two from `md` — on the left the name, the address, the telephone number and the message, on the right what the person says about themselves (§765) — the consents and the button full width beneath.

**What changed nothing:** the roles' rules, the server validation, the other volunteer emails, the agreement, the privacy notice's text. **Refused:** an open (unfolded) list on the form — the register page folds its own and the thank-you says it again; a second email for the steps; reading the outbox row from the page (a read for a sentence); a new cookie (the registration's facts cookie is on another path and holds the same kind of facts). **For the owner to decide:** whether the steps should be open on the volunteers' page, where no journey strip stands above them as on the register page.
changelogLine: - **The volunteers' page says what happens, and the form is wider** — four steps under the intro («Completezi formularul», the receipt email, «Organizatorii îți aleg rolul și te confirmă», the day), a thank-you like the registration's with «Ce urmează» and when the receipt leaves, the same facts in the receipt email, and a form as wide as the register page with its boxes in two columns on a desktop. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criteria 33, 39, 40 and 48 (§754, §768, §773, §797). Given an event that takes volunteers, when a visitor opens the volunteers' page, then the page is as wide as the register page (`PAGE_WIDTH`) and the form has no 560-pixel cap, its boxes standing in one column on a phone and in two from `md` up; under the intro and above «Ce ești dispus(ă) să faci» stands a closed fold «Cum funcționează voluntariatul» with four numbered steps and a glyph each — the form, the receipt email, the organizers choosing the role and confirming by email with nothing owed until then, the day — whose third step adds that the parent's consent comes first only where the club takes minors and whose last points to the category's contact person only when one is shown, with no number and no deadline in it; the intro no longer says that the organizers confirm. When the offer was sent, then the thank-you is a status panel (`volunteer-done`) with the heading «Mulțumim, <first name>!» (or «Mulțumim!»), the lead naming the event and its date, when the receipt leaves (now, at the next pass, or that it left; only that it comes to the address written when the browser kept nothing) and «Ce urmează» in the steps' own words, with the parent's consent as its second item (`volunteer-done-guardian`) where minors are taken, the same for a new person and a repeat (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 34. Given a kept offer, when the receipt email `VOLUNTEER_RECEIVED` is sent, then it keeps its subject, the agreement line, the parent's consent line and the not-you line, and says in both languages «Ce urmează» — the organizers choose the role and confirm, the role comes by email with the date and place, nothing is owed until then — and a line for the day, with no number, deadline or club name of its own; the club's copy editor starts from those words, and a text the club saved for the message keeps its own until «Revino la textul implicit» (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the volunteers' page: the steps and «we will confirm you», before the form and after it, and in the receipt email; a wider form
